from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A company's diluted earnings per share from one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share value for the period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this metric")
    quote: str = Field(description="The verbatim line containing the diluted EPS value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
